name: Shared calibration margin for the calibrated waiting rules on B3
reason: Review of main(1) items P0-1 and P0-2: the history-conditioned fixed waits reached 0.9 evaluation success in only 6 of 20 splits, so the 4.8-min gain may depend on a fixed comparator sitting at the edge of the empirical target; and the matched-success comparison between the history and smoothed estimators must be shown with its selection procedure.

calibration_targets.definition: the same calibration target 0.9 + epsilon (epsilon 0, 0.02, 0.04) for every rule; the evaluation criterion stays 0.9; margins fixed here, never chosen from evaluation results

rules.current_and_history: first threshold on the grid whose calibration success reaches the target (version-3 heuristic); history likelihood s.d. max(noise, 0.001)
rules.smoothed: for each scale 2, 4, 8, 16 min the first such threshold; then the scale with the smallest calibration mean completion among scales reaching the target (else the scale with the largest calibration success)
rules.single_fixed_wait: first wait on {0, 2, ..., 120} min whose calibration success reaches the target (version 3)
rules.conditioned_fixed_pooled: waits (tau_3, tau_30) minimizing the equal-weight calibration mean completion subject to equal-weight calibration success >= target; ties: smaller tau_3 + tau_30, then smaller tau_3
rules.conditioned_fixed_per_history: the same objective subject to calibration success >= target for each history
rules.fallback: largest threshold or wait 120 min (both histories) with target_reached = false

threshold_grids.coarse: version-3 grid {0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.85, 0.9, 0.95, 0.975, 0.99} (primary; target 0.90 reproduces version 3 and the robustness study)

settings.splits: the 20 calibration/evaluation splits of the robustness study: split seed 20261006 + r; observation draws of version 2 for r = 0 and seed 20261005 + 10000 r otherwise (with per-plant offsets as in the robustness study), scaled to the noise level

outputs.per_split: calibration choices, evaluation success and mean failure-penalized completion (all and per history) for every rule and the oracle
outputs.paired: per evaluation sample differences, each averaged over both histories: history - conditioned pooled, smoothed - conditioned pooled, history - smoothed, history - single fixed (success and completion)
outputs.bootstrap: 95% percentile intervals for r = 0 with 2000 resamples (seed 20261008); resampling unit: the evaluation posterior sample, keeping both histories and all rules paired
outputs.summary: per setting, grid and target: splits whose evaluation success reaches 0.9 for each rule; median, minimum and maximum of success, completion and the paired differences; splits in which history (smoothed) is faster than the conditioned pooled waits and history is faster than smoothed
outputs.matched_success: calibration-side comparison of history and smoothed on the fine grid at each target (rules frozen on calibration samples, then evaluated); plus, descriptively, the evaluation frontier points of the frozen baselines study (history and 16-min smoothed estimators) attaining evaluation success 0.90, 0.92 and 0.94: threshold, success and completion

reporting: All results reported whatever their direction; simulation of one published model structure; the target is an empirical calibration target, not a coverage guarantee; a margin sensitivity is not a coverage guarantee either.
